items.title: Lillian Hardin Armstrong Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: That was my stepfather. So, she sent Mr. Miller to investigate this dump I'm playing in.

ctx.x: And, one day she was on the porch and a lady came by and said, I saw your little girl at the cabaret last night. Oh. She said, my little girl? I said, yeah. I said, I saw her playing at the cabaret last night. And, my mother said, well, I, I don't know. She said, well, all right. And, when the lady left, she says to me, what were you doing playing at a cabaret last night? So, I said, oh, the, the studio gave an exhibition and I had to play for them. Ha! Said, oh, just one exhibition? I said, yes. So, that went…
